_comment: Sitting hints for the graduation cockpit. TRANSCRIPTION ONLY — every suggestedVerdict/
suggestedCategory below is copied from the pre-filled recommendation already written in
eval/ADJUDICATION_QUEUE.md (the R-number in `ref`); notes for the 2026-08-12/14 drafts
are factual annotations from the session exports / run-test event log. Where the queue
doc offers two defensible rulings or an open policy call, NO verdict is suggested — the
note states the choice instead. The cockpit renders these as amber suggestions the
human ratifies or overrides; hints are never ground truth and never auto-applied.
